releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.12.0 adds live remaining-file counts under the circular Files > Search filters. All, Doc, Photo and Video now show their complete remaining Search totals, excluding files already assigned to a Category and without being limited by the visible result window or filename query. The counts update immediately after single or multi-delete and after Add to Category, so the remaining amount is always visible. The existing circular filter design, document/photo/video selection, permanent delete, multi-select and Category behavior remain unchanged.
